title: LLM辅助系统评价筛选中的辅助不确定性信号：基于八个Cohen药物类综述的基准测试
summary: 该研究提出使用辅助BERT+GCN分类器为LLM在系统评价标题-摘要筛选中提供结构化不确定性信号，提升筛选效率。在八个药物类数据集上评估五种提示交付策略，发现全上下文交付显著提升F1和WSS@95，MAYBE-only路由帕累托最优，两遍设计无法自我分诊。
summary_en: This study proposes an auxiliary BERT+GCN classifier to provide structured uncertainty signals for LLM-based title-abstract screening in systematic reviews, improving efficiency. Evaluated on eight drug-class datasets, full-context delivery improves F1 and WSS@95, MAYBE-only routing is Pareto-optimal, and two-pass design fails to self-triage.
